title: Undamped SDOF step response with continuous and scheme-exact Newmark references
source: N. M. Newmark (1959), A method of computation for structural dynamics, Journal of the Engineering Mechanics Division 85(EM3), 67–94; continuous closed-form step response and the exact average-acceleration discrete frequency for m=1, k=4, F=1.

quantities.reason: The exact step response is u=(F/k)(1-cos(omega t)); the average-acceleration phase error is O((omega*dt)^2/12) with omega=2 rad/s and dt=0.001 s, so 2e-6 bounds the accumulated time-discretisation error.
The exact step response is v=(F/(m omega)) sin(omega t); the same fixed-step Newmark phase-error bound is used.

quantities.quantity: displacement at t=0.1 s, average-acceleration scheme-exact reference
quantities.reason: For average acceleration, omega_tilde=(2/dt) atan(omega dt/2); the exact discrete displacement is (F/k)(1-cos(omega_tilde t)) and the velocity is (F/(m omega)) sin(omega_tilde t). The 1e-12 band isolates implementation error from the larger continuous phase error.
